title: The migration chain: untyped N to N+1 steps run on read
body: Each step is a function from the ref's files as serde_json::Value to the next schema's. decode runs the chain from meta.schema_version to SCHEMA_VERSION before the typed parse. No old structs are kept.
close_reason: migrate.rs: untyped N to N+1 steps composed on read, retired schemas name the foam to go through; unit tests on a fake chain
